messages:
diego: Follow-up from the pm: we keep getting short lived route churn tied to resolver edge behavior. This time traces show lots of EDNS timeouts and then immediate host blacklist -> TLS fallback mismatches. Need owners & short timelines.
anya: saw the same. Around 02:41 UTC the resolver returned NXDOMAIN/EDNS-TRUNC and the LB retried DNS rapidly, causing a rotation spike.
li: can someone paste the exact log pattern? Curious whether it's SERVFAIL vs NXDOMAIN vs truncated responses.
diego: snippet from edge:
```
2026-04-11T02:41:04Z dns.client: query=svc.prod.internal edns_size=4096 response=TRUNCATED
2026-04-11T02:41:04Z lb.edge: resolve_retry host=svc.prod.internal attempt=1
2026-04-11T02:41:04Z lb.edge: host_blacklist_add host=10.23.7.12 reason=resolve_fail
2026-04-11T02:41:04Z tls.cache: fallback_cert_mismatch host=10.23.7.12
```
noah: TRUNCATED is important here 12; indicates EDNS/UDP issues -> client falls back to TCP and we currently treat immediate retry as failure.
tia: ok practical actions I propose: keep them small and measurable.
- C1: Add resolver backoff wrapper that treats `TRUNCATED` as a soft failure: do a TCP retry before returning fail (owner: li). ETA: PR in 72h, canary in 6 days.
- C2: Expose EDNS size and TCP fallback counters as metrics and an alert when TCP fallback rate > 1% sustained (owner: anya). ETA: metric in 48h.
- C3: Adjust blacklist policy: don't blacklist on a single resolve error if the response is `TRUNCATED` or `NXDOMAIN`; require 2 distinct failure categories within 10s (owner: noah). ETA: design + PR in 1 week.
- C4: Add a short "hold" window after cert reloads to avoid SNI mismatch when fallback happens during rotation (owner: diego). ETA: config change in 3 days.
- C5: Run a 24h targeted probe that queries upstream DNS with both EDNS/UDP and TCP and surfaces regions with high truncation (owner: tia). ETA: probe running in 5 days.
li: I'll take C1. Implementation note: will keep retry logic in lb-resolver module, TCP retry only for `TRUNCATED`, keep counters. Will add unit tests mocking UDP->TCP fallback.
anya: C2 I'll add grafana panels and a Prom alert. we'll gate on sustained rate for 5m to avoid noise.
noah: For C3 I'll sketch the state machine: failures are categorized into {NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, TRUNCATED, TIMEOUT}. blacklist requires either 2 different categories in 10s or the same category 3x in 30s. Will post doc.
diego: infra-bot: create ticket for these follow-ups and link to postmortem.
infra-bot: Created INC-4699: https://tracker.internal/INC-4699 - "edge: resolver backoff + EDNS handling follow-ups" assigned to triage
tia: I'll prototype the probe using a small lambda that runs both UDP+TCP queries and records truncation + latency. posting script to INC-4699 when ready.
li: starting C1 branch now. will ping #eng-runtime when PR is up.
anya: once metrics from C2 exist we'll baseline current truncation rates and set sensible alert thresholds.
diego: good. please update INC-4699 with PR links, dashboards, and runbook changes. syncing Friday morning to confirm status. If anything blocks, escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
